newsitem.title: USA: Maine lawmakers raise supplemental budget concerns.
newsitem.headline: Maine lawmakers raise supplemental budget concerns.

text.p: Members of the Maine legislature's budget-writing committee said they are concerned about many of the items in Gov. Angus King's proposed $32 million dollar supplemental budget.
Some members said most of the items are not an emergency and should wait for the new two-year budget that will be considered later in the month.

King wants to spend $10 million dollars for capital repairs and improvements, a plan that has drawn opposition. And the governor wants to put $13 million dollars in a reserve called the rainy day fund. Some lawmakers would rather use that money for additional school aid.
